The solver integrates $\dot\varepsilon_{\mathrm{in}} = A(T)\,(\sigma_{\mathrm{vm}}-\sigma_y)^{n(T)}$ with a zero yield surface ($\sigma_y = 10^{-6}$~MPa), i.e., the applied von~Mises stress the laws were fitted in, with no rate-independent hardening; the law enters as a temperature-dependent Norton surrogate fitted at every 2.5-$^\circ$C row of the card (listed at 25-$^\circ$C steps) over the stress window the joints visit, 5--40~MPa hot, 10--60~MPa cold (initial (not iterated)); surrogate rate error at most 30\,\% (hot dwell) and 48\,\% (cold dwell). Elasticity: $E(T) = 45 - 0.12\,(T-25)$~GPa (floor 5~GPa), $\nu$ = 0.36 (assumption (room-temperature band, Paska 2024; slope assumed)); thermal expansion 21.5~ppm/K, stress-free at 25\,$^\circ$C.\par
\endgroup

\noindent\emph{Limitations of the solder laws.}
\begin{itemize}
\item The production law (Schubert et al.) was fitted to SnAgCu (near-eutectic SAC); applied to SAC305 in the citing literature, not to the joint's SAC305 (BGA).
\item Its constants are reprinted without their data window, so its calibration window is not stated; inside the measured window of the band laws its creep rate is 13--73 times the measured Sn3.9Ag0.6Cu rates (geometric mean 40).
\item The band law Xiao and Armstrong (Sn3.9Ag0.6Cu (NOT SAC305; DEFECT \#41)) is calibrated on 45--150\,$^\circ$C, 7.51--15.92~MPa; the joints visit 5--40~MPa hot, 10--60~MPa cold, which extrapolates stress 5--60~MPa visited against 7.51--15.92~MPa; the 25-$^\circ$C cold dwell (rows below 45\,$^\circ$C).
\item The band law measured Norton fits (Sn3.9Ag0.6Cu (NOT SAC305)) is calibrated on 45--150\,$^\circ$C, 7.51--15.92~MPa; the joints visit 5--40~MPa hot, 10--60~MPa cold, which extrapolates stress 5--60~MPa visited against 7.51--15.92~MPa; the 25-$^\circ$C cold dwell (rows below 45\,$^\circ$C).
\item The Norton surrogate reproduces the production law within 30\,\% (hot dwell) and 48\,\% (cold dwell) in rate over the visited window; the error travels with the card.
\item The visited window is the configured initial one: the iteration of the window to self-consistency has not been run.
\end{itemize}

Discretization: a GCI-type estimate on the nested ladder r11/r21/r31 of $D$ itself (the observed order with $F_s = 1.25$ where the ladder is asymptotic, $|p - 2| \leq 0.2$; otherwise $F_s = 3$ with the order limited to [0.5, 2]), so errors shared on one mesh family cancel only where they move together; the through-thickness split r11$\to$r12 ($F_s = 3$), the E--T stop of each case and the matched-reference agreement of the solver, in quadrature. Columns: the components of each integration's S0 reference ladder (cooling~A production case), relative to the value (temperatures: to the rise above the inlet); $U_{95}$ of each compared case; $\dagger$: the case has no ladder of its own and carries its reference's estimate provisionally (identical mesh; 6 ladder rungs listed for the campaign). $\deps$: own local numerical $U$ (L0$\to$L3, cycle count), resolved only when resolved under every law of the solder-law band (L: production law only) (solved on the S0 cases; not compared in this state). Model-form uncertainty is not part of $U$: it is covered by rerunning both integrations under each declared alternative (Table~\ref{tab:supp-variants}). Limits: GaN $T_J\le150$; $R_{DS(on)}$ temperature fit $\le125$; X7R/X7S/X7T capacitors $\le125$; inductor $\le125$; build-up dielectric and encapsulant $T_g\approx150$; board $T_g\approx170$; processor die $\le105$; solder law calibrated $\le125$, solidus 217; the current of every power ball at the case's waveform a stated requirement on the package (target 2.0~A, 1.5~A as sensitivity), reported, not a filter, with at least 25\,\% of the ball sites left for signals; static drop $\le30$~mV per rail. Cases: integration, cooling (A: top plate; B: top plate and bottom plate, the bottom one behind a 50-\textmu m TIM) and input state when not the production state SDEC (implemented decoupling): S0, ideal input smoothing; S1, no decoupling; Z3 always with the coupled land-side redistribution. A check that fails only on the whole-field bound is unresolved; such a candidate is not ranked either.\par
\endgroup
